name: agentic-app-chat-interface
context: Design a chat interface for an AI-powered agentic application. The audience is knowledge workers interacting with AI assistants for tasks such as code generation, analysis, and decision support. Target platforms: desktop (primary) and mobile responsive. The interface must handle streaming text, code blocks, multi-turn conversations, and agent status indicators while remaining clean and scannable.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json: use monospace pairing for code blocks, body scale for messages
Apply color.rules.json: distinct but accessible colors for user vs agent messages
Layout must support full-height chat panel with input area pinned at bottom
Motion presets for message entry animations and typing indicators
Code block styling must use Token_System surface and border tokens
Comply with Quality_Gate: clear message attribution, proper reading order, token-only values

outputCriteria.format: Chat interface spec with message list, input area, agent status, and code rendering using token references
qualityChecks: User and agent messages visually distinct via surface token differentiation
Code blocks use proper typography tokens and surface contrast
Input area maintains consistent spacing and sizing from Token_System
All interactive elements have documented states
accessibilityRequirements: Chat messages are in a live region (aria-live=polite) for screen reader announcements
Message input supports multiline and is properly labeled
Code blocks are contained in elements with role and accessible copy functionality
Agent status changes are announced to assistive technology
Full keyboard navigation through message history and actions

examples.description: Chat message thread with user message, agent response containing a code block, and typing indicator
examples.output:
Organism: ChatInterface
  Layout: flex(direction=column, height=100vh)
  Children:
    - Organism: MessageList(flex=1, overflow=auto, padding: var(--space-md))
        role: log, aria-live: polite
        Children:
          - Molecule: UserMessage
              align: flex-end
              bg: var(--color-surface-user-message)
              radius: var(--radius-md)
              padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md)
              - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.md, color=color.text.primary)
              motion: enter-exit.slide-in-right
          - Molecule: AgentMessage
              align: flex-start
              bg: var(--color-surface-agent-message)
              radius: var(--radius-md)
              padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md)
              - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.md, color=color.text.primary)
              - Molecule: CodeBlock
                  bg: var(--color-surface-code)
                  border: var(--border-subtle)
                  radius: var(--radius-sm)
                  padding: var(--space-sm)
                  font: typography.mono.sm
              motion: enter-exit.fade-up
    - Molecule: ChatInput(position=sticky, bottom=0)
        bg: var(--color-surface-primary)
        border-top: var(--border-default)
        padding: var(--space-md)
        - Atom: TextArea(ariaLabel='Message input', rows=1, autoExpand=true)
        - Atom: Button(variant=primary, ariaLabel='Send message', icon=send)
acceptanceCriteria: User and agent messages use different surface tokens for visual distinction
Code block uses dedicated surface and monospace typography tokens
Message entry uses Motion_Library enter-exit presets
Chat container uses aria-live for new message announcements
All values are token references from Token_System
